app.title: Fab Night Shift

quest.title: ETCH CD shift
quest.toggle: Collapse or expand the task list
quest.q1: Check the SPC alarm at the PE workstation

hint.controls: Arrow keys / WASD to walk · Click the floor to walk there · Click a tool or person to walk over and interact · E / Space to interact · Esc closes windows · C opens the clue book · J the Evidence Log · K the Codex · Click the game once so the keyboard works

shower.title: Air shower…

verb.pc: Log in to the PE workstation
toast.noSuit: You can't enter the fab without a cleanroom suit! Change at the lockers in the gowning room first.
toast.showerDone: Air shower done. Welcome to Fab 9. Don't touch your face.
toast.clueDup: That clue is already in your clue book.
toast.suitOff: You take off the cleanroom suit and hang it back in the locker.
toast.coffeeEmpty: Out of coffee. So sleepy… Go make a cup in the office.
toast.inControl: That point is within the control limits.
toast.rcIncomplete: Fill in all three blanks before submitting.
toast.rcNeedEvidence: You're on the right track, but with fewer than 3 clues Manager Wang will tear it apart.

toast.ticket: Ticket EE-2610-0871 sent to the on-call equipment engineer. Response time: 20 minutes (optimistically).
